newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba Specialty priced at 110 Sfr/share. [CORRECTED 8:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ciba Specialty priced at 110 Sfr/share. [CORRECTED 8:53 GMT]

text.p: The issue price for Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding Inc's global offering has been fixed at 110 Swiss francs per share, a company spokeswoman said.
She said 3.01 million shares were allocated. (Corrects from "3.01 million francs")
"The price of the global offer has been fixed at 110 Swiss francs per share," the company said in a statement.

"In the global offer, a total of 3,013,489 shares were allocated to investors. No new shares were issed by the company in connection with the global offer and settlement will take place on March 20, 1997," it said.
The 110 issue price values the company at around 7.93 billion francs. Shares start trading today on the Swiss Exchange and SEAQ International.
It said more than 20,000 employees would get an inaugural grant certificate entitling each to the market value of one share on March 1, 2000 and which can be redeemed in March 2000.
"This clearly indicates to all our employees the importance of the contribution in delivering shareholder value," Ciba SC Chairman Rolf Meyer said in the statement.

Subscription rights for Ciba SC, spun off via a one-for-one rights issue to Novartis shareholders, had closed at 103.50 francs on Tuesday, well above the 90 francs per right bid price set on Monday night by a bank consortium.
The rights price had valued Ciba SC shares at 113.50 francs given the 10-franc subscription charge and valued the company at some 8.2 billion francs.
The implied price/earnings ratio at that level for the rights put Ciba SC at a premium to Clariant and other specialty chemical companies in Europe.
Ciba SC had 1996 sales of more than 6.7 billion francs from additives, consumer care chemicals, polymers, pigments and textile dyes.
It is the world's market leader in additives, whiteners, certain polymers and pigments. It is second in textile dyes.
The consortium used the rights it acquired to buy shares in Ciba SC to be resold in the global offering.
